notes: Declarative OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoints. Each entry names only env var names, never a literal base URL or key. packages/ai/providers/factory's createGatewayAdapter builds a working adapter straight from one of these entries plus a resolved env source, through createOpenAICompatAdapter, createOpenAIAdapter or createAnthropicAdapter, so a new gateway needs no dedicated provider package. Validated by scripts/validate-gateways.mjs. See docs/guides/add-a-gateway.md.

governance.note: Worked example only: this gateway definition is not wired into live provider selection. The production OpenRouter route stays on its dedicated open_router harness and @agiworkforce/providers-openrouter package (packages/ai/model-registry/catalog/harnesses.json, packages/ai/model-registry/catalog/provider-governance.json). Every field here is real and verified against OpenRouter's own published endpoint and privacy docs, retrieved 2026-09-05, chosen because Part 1 of this change independently verified the same facts.
